memory_update.text: Restaurants theme should not be screened only by branded restaurant traffic; higher-quality Serenity lanes include franchisee unit economics, procurement scale, digital demand capture, foodservice inputs, approved-vendor relationships, and equipment/service infrastructure.

Restaurant POS, loyalty, ordering, payments, and back-office software are high-priority underfollowed nodes because they can control customer data, throughput, labor efficiency, and franchise-system standardization.

Private-label coffee, beverage extracts, DSD beverage service, and foodservice consumables remain promising underfollowed nodes; WEST and FARM are seed names but require filings-based verification of current restaurant customer exposure and financial durability.

Domino's and Yum should be retained primarily as reference leaders for procurement scale, franchisee economics, supply-chain coordination, and digital ordering economics rather than as the only investable expression of the restaurants theme.

Layer 1 universe still needs expansion into foodservice distributors, packaging suppliers, cold-chain logistics, sanitation/maintenance vendors, dairy/cheese/protein suppliers, and restaurant facilities-service companies.

summary: Layer 1C merged the visible Layer 1B restaurant-theme candidates into a deduplicated, Serenity-ranked initial universe. The strongest current structure is a two-lane funnel: reference leaders such as Domino's and Yum define the restaurant franchise, procurement-scale, and unit-economics model, while underfollowed candidates sit in restaurant technology, private-label beverages, foodservice inputs, commercial kitchen equipment, and hidden supply-chain infrastructure. The universe is intentionally not a list of only restaurant brands; it prioritizes companies that may benefit from franchisee economics, digital ordering control, approved-vendor penetration, recurring beverage/ingredient demand, remodel capex, and outsourced supply-chain complexity. Current evidence is still narrow and requires filings-based validation before later-layer promotion.
universe_method: multi-step: theme decomposition -> node expansion -> dedupe/rank
